The source's chosen big fppf site and base-scheme conventions remain in force, and terms such as algebraic space refer to fppf sheaves with representable diagonal and an étale surjective scheme atlas.

Let $S$ be a scheme. Let $X$ be an algebraic space over $S$.
The following quantities are equal:
\begin{enumerate}
\item The dimension of $X$.
\item The supremum of the dimensions of the local rings of $X$.
\item The supremum of $\dim_x(X)$ for $x \in |X|$.
\end{enumerate}
